question: How do I register for a workshop?
answer: Navigate to the Events page, view the workshop details, and click the Register for Event button.

question: Can I update my student department after registration?
answer: Yes, you can modify your academic details anytime by logging in and visiting your Profile page.

question: What should I do if I forget my account password?
answer: Click on Forgot Password on the Login page. Enter your registered email to receive a password reset link.

question: How long does admin approval take for new student accounts?
answer: Student registration verification takes 24 to 48 hours. Once approved, you gain full access to your student dashboard.

question: Are campus workshops and events free to attend?
answer: Most campus workshops, hackathons, and guest lectures are completely free for registered students unless noted.

question: Can I cancel my event registration if I cannot attend?
answer: Yes. Go to your Dashboard, locate the event under Registered Events, and click Cancel Request to free up your seat.

question: Will I receive a participation certificate after attending workshops?
answer: Digital certificates are generated within 3 business days following the event and can be downloaded from your profile.

question: How do I submit an event proposal as a club coordinator?
answer: Navigate to Contact page, select Event Proposal category, and submit the proposal form for admin evaluation.

question: What browsers are supported by StudentHub?
answer: StudentHub works with modern web browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari, and mobile browsers.

question: Where can I view academic notices and exam schedules?
answer: Exam schedules and notices are posted in the Latest Notices section of the Home page and on the Dashboard.

question: How do I contact student support for technical difficulties?
answer: You can reach out to IT support via the Contact page or by emailing support@charusat.edu.in.

question: Can I form inter-department teams for hackathons?
answer: Yes, hackathon rules allow cross-department teams of up to 4 students across any study year.

question: How do I upload or update my profile photo?
answer: Visit your Profile page, click Choose File under profile photo, and save changes. Files must be JPG or PNG under 5MB.

question: Where do I track my submitted feedback and queries?
answer: Responses to feedback submissions are sent directly to your registered student email address.

question: Are alumni permitted to register for campus webinars?
answer: Select public webinars are open to alumni. Look for the Open to Alumni badge in the event description.

question: How do I apply for student club membership?
answer: Join club introduction meetings during Orientation Week or submit a membership request through the About page.
